x-summary: Whether a person is fit for duty, and any duty restrictions. No diagnoses.
title: FitnessForDuty
description: Medical readiness status — the only medically derived fact line commanders and HR see (docs/design/access-control-phase1.md). Holds the conclusion and any duty restrictions, never the diagnosis; diagnoses stay in medical_condition, which needs medical.read.

status.x-help: Downgraded means fit for limited duty; non-effective means not fit for duty.
status.description: Fit for duty; downgraded (limited duty); non-effective (not fit for duty).

restrictions.x-help: What the person must not do. Do not name a diagnosis here.
restrictions.description: Duty limitations in plain terms (e.g. no heavy lifting). Must not name a diagnosis.

assessedBy.description: Who made the assessment (name or post).

basis.x-help: The document this status is based on, e.g. a medical board conclusion number.
